how: race_gear.py: Dwarf is Alliance, so it can't wear the Horde rewards of the preset's level60_phase0_rogue_seal_fate_swords. It wears level60_phase0_rogue_seal_fate_swords_alliance, the same set with those slots re-ranked at a Alliance race (bis_phase0.sh RANK_ONLY SLOTS), kept by the rule, without a sim. On it, Dwarf hit 11.2% against the 8% yellow cap, the set's own hit 7.2%: 1% (10 budget points) re-spent over the set's shares at the 1b prices (Agility 66.0%, CritRating 18.8%, AttackPowerBoth 12.5%, Strength 2.7%). Hit and crit are one pool for the gear, so each is written once. Dwarf 828.8 with the set, 829.6 with the swap; gain.se is the paired error (the same seeded fights), 0.37 unpaired.
